password.title: Change password
password.done: Password changed. Your other sessions were signed out.

sessions.title: Active sessions
sessions.revokeDescription: The browser using that session will be signed out and has to sign in again.

mfa.title: Two-factor sign-in
mfa.intro: Protect your account with a code from an authenticator app (for example Microsoft or Google Authenticator) in addition to your password.
mfa.scan: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
mfa.qrTitle: QR code for the authenticator app
mfa.manual: Or type this key into the app:
mfa.recoveryHint: Keep these codes somewhere safe. Each one signs you in once if you lose your phone. They are shown only now.
mfa.disableHint: To turn off two-factor sign-in, enter your password.
mfa.required: Your organization requires two-factor sign-in for Admins. Set it up to continue.
